steps: At Quest initialization shuffle the nine ordinary Room copy IDs once with existing SeededRandom/Fisher-Yates; reserve Boss Room separately.
Shuffle all eligible Ruins + Common physical Monster copy IDs once, excluding permanent removals and copies owned by other encounters.
On Room reveal take saved Room queue head without RNG, bind its exact corresponding tile; no fallback geometry.

Draw Monster queue heads sequentially into Stance slots Aggressive to Support. Large uses two slots and higher-priority Stance. When the fourth slot draw is Large replace the last non-Large drawn Monster and shift towards Aggressive, per p17.
Hero Stances are player selected, not randomized; starting Areas follow the tile by Stance. Monster placement follows drawn Stance.
Use four Hero and one per living Monster Initiative cards; shuffle once with existing seeded helper.
Save Room/card/tile IDs, copy ownership, draw queues, placements, Stances, initiative, RNG before and after, and source-contract version atomically.
Reload validates and consumes stored result; never re-shuffle or redraw. At battle end Monster cards return and shuffle; Room card stays discarded until Dungeon run ends.
rngConsumption: Room deck Fisher-Yates: n-1 draws at setup
Monster deck Fisher-Yates: n-1 draws at setup
No RNG for queue-head draw or printed placement
Initiative Fisher-Yates: n-1 draws at battle initialization
Monster deck return/shuffle at Battle end: n-1 draws
